lessons: Avoid starting with declarative background facts or process descriptions (like tree sap composition), as they trigger massive initial drop-offs up to 38.5%.
Eliminate mid-video pauses and guessing prompts (e.g., 'Pause and guess...'), which cause immediate abandonment (15.4% drop).
Keep hook lines directly tied to counter-intuitive sensory experiences rather than abstract statements to minimize early viewer bleeding.
Not enough data to definitively rank best-holding script structures due to small sample size and consistently low end-retention across all videos.
worst_moment_types: Explanatory background filler facts early in the video
Mid-video rhetorical questions paired with pauses
